source: PC Do It Yourself: 'use cut-off electric cable with socket' is one of the eight (Steam guide 2584421942). The mobile L113 ElectricTrap sits at transform z -0.001, its box inside the basement back door's, so the click ray hits the door; the same trap in L111/L114 sits at z -0.219 and wins the ray — the profile gives L113's the same depth. PC anger (game.exe, docs/PC_ROUTINES.md "The anger and the bonus"): PCAngryTime on the Rottweiler is level_DIY/level.xml's angrytime=228 (1/12 s ticks: the level state ticks 12 times a second, as the HUD clock shows) — the rage current a trick without its own value is set to and the mercury's full scale; PCAngryTime on an item is its tricks.xml angrytime (GroundMarbles 264); the profile holds the current 60 ticks, counts it down one per tick and pays +3 for a trick fired while it is above zero (pcprofile.s1_rage_*).
